verdicts.defect: A discard whose pathspec mixes tracked-modified and untracked files restores none of the tracked ones. discardChanges (extensions.ts:2632) runs `git checkout -- <all paths>`, and git aborts the whole pathspec with "error: pathspec 'x' did not match any file(s) known to git" as soon as one path is untracked; the error is swallowed by `2>/dev/null || true`, then `git clean` removes the untracked files anyway. Observed twice on demo: barn-review-w6-b.txt and w6-check-probe.ts were deleted while pages/Home.vue stayed modified, and reproduced by hand in the pod (exit=1 from checkout, "Removing barn-review-w6-c.txt", pages/Home.vue still M). The screen does not lie about it - the BARN-DISCARD-LEFT check throws "the discard did not take" - but the press leaves a half-discarded tree. A single-path discard ("Revert this file") works on both tracked and untracked files, so the fix is to split the pathspec, or to run checkout only over the paths git knows.
